intro: Loni, in Ghaziabad district on the Delhi border, has filled up quickly with builder floors, new housing societies and private schools. Many of these projects set aside a play area but have to fund it in stages. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,130 km away, and sends it to the Delhi NCR region by road.

A phased plan is often the sensible way to buy. We draw the full layout once, with the safe play area for every future piece marked, and you install the first part now. When the next budget is approved, the new equipment fits into space that has already been kept clear. Our team or a dealer in north India handles installation at each stage.

sections.html:
Start with the pieces children use most. For a society with young families, that is usually a swing set, a slide and two spring riders. In the second phase, add a multi play system from Play Lands for older children, and later an open gym for adults along the edge.

Lay the base and drainage for the whole area in the first phase, even if some of it stays empty, because breaking up a finished floor later costs more. Loni's summers are hot and its winters cold and foggy, and galvanised frames with roto-moulded parts suit both. For adult fitness, see our outdoor gym page for Loni.

faq.q: Can we buy playground equipment in stages for a Loni society?
faq.a: Yes. We draw the complete layout first and mark the safe play area for each piece, so equipment added in later phases fits without moving what is already installed.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Loni and Ghaziabad?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is made in Vasai, sent by road and installed by our own team or a dealer in north India, either grouted or self-standing depending on your base.

faq.q: What should the first phase include?
faq.a: The base, drainage and flooring for the whole area, plus the pieces children use most, usually swings, a slide and spring riders. Larger structures can follow.

intro: Machilipatnam is an old port town on the Krishna district coast, known for its Kalamkari textiles and its exposure to the Bay of Bengal. Cyclones and strong coastal winds reach this stretch of Andhra Pradesh, usually between October and December. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 940 km away, and delivers it to coastal Andhra by road.

Schools, colonies and public parks here need equipment that stays firmly in the ground in a storm and resists salt in the air the rest of the year. Tell us about your site, the ages of the children and how close you are to the sea. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and install through our team or a dealer once you approve.

sections.h: Securing equipment on a cyclone-prone coast
sections.html:
On an exposed coastal site, choose grouted installation, with each post set in concrete, over a self-standing base. Tall, broad structures catch more wind, so a lower layout with separate swings, see-saws and climbers can make more sense than one high tower.

After any severe storm, walk the play area before children return. Check for loose bolts, debris caught in nets and damage from fallen branches, and call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if anything is broken. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist the salt that settles between storms, and a fresh-water rinse now and then helps them last.

faq.q: Is grouting necessary for playground equipment near the coast?
faq.a: On exposed sites, yes. Setting each post in concrete holds the equipment firmly in strong winds. Self-standing bases suit sheltered courtyards where digging is not possible.

faq.q: What should we check after a cyclone?
faq.a: Look for loose fixings, debris in nets and damage from branches before children use the equipment again. Contact our after-sales team for any parts that need replacing.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Machilipatnam?
faq.a: Yes. We supply schools, colonies and parks in coastal Andhra Pradesh, with equipment made in Vasai and installed by our team or a regional dealer.

intro: Madanapalle sits on a plateau in the Rayalaseema region, cooler than the plains below it and surrounded by farmland and hills. The area is home to residential schools as well as day schools, and a boarding campus uses its playground very differently from a city school. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment in Vasai, about 880 km away, and sends it by road.

On a residential campus, children play in the evenings and on weekends as well as at break, often in mixed-age groups with less adult supervision. We plan for that from the start. Send us the campus plan, the age range of your students and photos of the ground, and we will suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.html:
Boarding students use the same equipment for years, so they need pieces that stay interesting. Structures that invite group games and imagination work well here. Our Nature Sparsh collection, designed by our own team, includes play stations such as Card Pyramid that groups of children explore together.

Place the playground within view of a hostel or staff quarters, and light the path to it if children use it after sunset. The plateau climate is milder than much of Andhra Pradesh. Rain and sun still wear surfaces, though, so we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits a residential school?
faq.a: Group play structures and climbers that hold older children's interest over several years, alongside a separate area for younger students. We plan both on one layout drawing.

faq.q: Can you deliver to a campus outside Madanapalle town?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from Vasai. Let us know about the approach road to the campus so the delivery vehicle can reach the site.

faq.q: Who installs the equipment?
faq.a: Our own installation team or a dealer in south India. We choose grouted or self-standing installation depending on the ground at your site.

intro: Madhyamgram, on the northern edge of Kolkata in North 24 Parganas, has seen a steady rise of apartment complexes over the last two decades. For a builder, the children's play area is one of the amenities buyers check at handover, and it has to be ready on time. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, roughly 1,650 km away, and delivers to the Kolkata region by road.

We work with developers from the planning stage. Share the amenity drawing, the area set aside for play and the expected age range of residents' children. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, and once you approve it, we manufacture, dispatch and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

sections.h: A builder's checklist for the play area
sections.html:
• Finalise the play area before landscaping, so the base, drainage and flooring are planned together.
  • Keep it away from driveways and the basement ramp, and fence it if it opens onto a road.
  • Ask for the layout drawing early and share it with your architect.
  • Plan seating for parents nearby, such as a bench from our garden decor range.

Kolkata's monsoon brings heavy rain and waterlogging, so set the play area slightly higher than the surrounding lawn. A compact multi play system from Clown Capade or Castle Crest photographs well for brochures and fits a modest podium or garden.

faq.q: Can you work with our architect on a Madhyamgram project?
faq.a: Yes. Share the amenity plan and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, which your architect can fit into the garden plan.

faq.q: How do we avoid waterlogging in the play area?
faq.a: Raise the base slightly above the lawn, give it a drainage slope and lay rubber flooring. Plan this before landscaping starts.

faq.q: Do you install in North 24 Parganas?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment travels by road from our Vasai factory and is installed by our own team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing.

intro: Mahbubnagar, the old Palamuru district of southern Telangana, is a dry region with hot summers and modest rainfall. Many of our enquiries from towns like this come from government and private schools with an open ground but a tight budget. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 610 km away, and sends it by road to sites across Telangana.

A large open ground does not need a large structure to be useful. A handful of well-placed individual pieces can serve a whole school if they are spaced properly. Send us the size of the ground, the number of students and some photos, and we will suggest a set of equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Getting the most from individual equipment
sections.html:
Individual pieces are a good way to start on a limited budget. A merry-go-round keeps a group of children busy at once. A see-saw needs a partner, which gets children playing together, and a double swing set covers the most popular activity on any school ground. Spread them out so groups do not crowd one another, and leave the full safe zone around each.

Red soil and hard ground in this region are firm enough for grouted installation, and rubber flooring under swings and slides stops the area wearing into a dust bowl. When budgets allow, a multi play system can be added to the same layout. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Mahbubnagar.

faq.q: What can a school in Mahbubnagar buy on a small budget?
faq.a: Individual pieces such as a swing set, a see-saw and a merry-go-round. They serve many children at once and can be added to later as funds allow.

faq.q: Do you supply schools across Telangana?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai and send equipment by road, with installation by our own team or a dealer in south India.

faq.q: Is rubber flooring necessary on dry ground?
faq.a: It is strongly advised under swings, slides and climbers. It cushions falls and keeps heavy-use spots from wearing into loose dust in the dry months.

intro: In Maheshtala and the neighbourhoods along the Hooghly south-west of Kolkata, much of children's outdoor life revolves around the local club and its small ground. These clubs, along with schools and municipal parks, are the main buyers of playground equipment here. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor play equipment at Vasai, near Mumbai, about 1,630 km away, and sends it to the Kolkata region by road.

A club ground usually doubles as a space for festivals, football and community events, so the playground has to share it. We help you decide where the equipment should go and how much space to keep open. Send photos of the ground and its measurements, and we will return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.html:
Place the equipment along one edge or in one corner of the ground, not in the middle, so the open space stays usable for games and pandal season. A boundary fence or low hedge between the play area and the football side keeps balls and running players away from small children.

Pieces that are fixed and simple suit a shared ground. Swing sets, see-saws and one compact multi play system give children enough to do without taking over the space. Hooghly-side ground stays damp through the monsoon, so we recommend grouting and rubber flooring. Fitness equipment for club members is on our Maheshtala outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Can a neighbourhood club in Maheshtala buy from FunPlay?
faq.a: Yes. We supply clubs, schools and parks. Share the ground size and photos, and we will suggest where the equipment should go and send a layout drawing.

faq.q: Where should the playground go on a ground used for football?
faq.a: Along one edge or corner, separated by a fence or hedge, so balls and running players stay away from small children.

faq.q: How is the equipment installed on damp ground?
faq.a: Usually by grouting each post in concrete, with rubber flooring on a drained base. Our team or a dealer in eastern India carries out the installation.

intro: Malda lies where the Ganga and the Mahananda meet in northern West Bengal, a district better known for its mango orchards than for anything else. Low-lying parts of the district flood in heavy monsoon years, and any outdoor equipment here has to cope with standing water. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, about 1,690 km away, and sends it by road.

We supply schools, municipal parks, housing colonies and private institutions in English Bazar and around the district. Share the size of your site and whether it has flooded in the past. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and arrange installation through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

sections.html:
If a site has held water in past monsoons, raise the play area on a compacted base above the flood line. Grout the posts in concrete so they stay firm when the soil is soaked. Galvanised steel resists rust after the water drains away, and roto-moulded plastic does not absorb moisture.

After a flood, clear silt from slides, decks and the flooring before reopening, and check every footing for movement. Rubber flooring can be washed and reused. For a school or park starting fresh, our 5 ft slides and see-saws are straightforward to inspect and clean. Adults can use the machines on our Malda outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed where the ground floods?
faq.a: Yes, on a raised, compacted base with posts grouted in concrete. Choose galvanised and roto-moulded equipment, and inspect the footings after any flood.

faq.q: What should we do after floodwater recedes?
faq.a: Clear silt from all surfaces, wash the rubber flooring and check each footing before children return. Report any damage to our after-sales team.

faq.q: Do you deliver to English Bazar and the rest of Malda district?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: Malegaon is a powerloom town in Nashik district, about 215 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes it one of the closer cities we supply. Its neighbourhoods are densely built, and schools and housing colonies here rarely have much open ground to spare. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for compact sites like these and delivers it by road.

Being in the same state as our factory keeps transport simple. We have also installed a playground for Raymond in Thane, closer to Mumbai. For your site, share the plot size, the age group and photos, and we will return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in Maharashtra.

sections.html:
When space is short, one multi play system usually gives more play than three separate pieces, because the slides, climbers and decks share a single safe zone. Look at the smaller structures in our Robo Romp and Clown Capade ranges, which pack several activities into a modest footprint.

Malegaon's summers are hot and dry, and the monsoon from June to September is moderate. Shade over the play area helps in April and May. Rubber flooring laid over a paved courtyard gives children a softer landing without digging up the ground. If the courtyard is also used for assembly, keep the equipment to one side so the open space stays clear. You can see our work on the Raymond, Thane project page.

faq.q: How far is Malegaon from your factory?
faq.a: About 215 km from our Vasai factory. We send equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in Maharashtra.

faq.q: What fits a small school courtyard?
faq.a: A compact multi play system that combines slides, climbing and a deck in one safe zone. Send us the courtyard measurements and we will suggest options.

faq.q: Can equipment be installed on a paved courtyard?
faq.a: Yes. A self-standing installation can work on a firm paved surface, with rubber flooring laid around the equipment to cushion falls.

intro: Mangalore receives some of the heaviest monsoon rain of any city on the west coast, from June well into September. Add the port, the sea breeze and the laterite soil, and you have a site that tests every outdoor material. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 750 km up the coast, and sends it to Dakshina Kannada by road.

The city's colleges, schools, housing projects and seaside hotels make up most of our enquiries here. Send us your site size, the age group and a few photos taken in both dry and wet weather if you have them. We will suggest equipment and a layout with the safe play area marked, then install through our own team or a dealer once you approve.

sections.h: Drainage first in a Mangalore monsoon
sections.html:
With this much rain, drainage decides whether a playground is usable for four months of the year. Build the play area on a raised base with a clear slope towards a drain, and avoid corners where runoff from roofs collects. Laterite is firm when dry and holds grouted posts well, but loose fill around the footings washes out quickly in heavy rain, so compact it properly.

We use galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts that do not rust in salty, humid air. A larger structure from our NexLev Series suits a college or hotel with space, while a society garden might start with spring riders and swings.

faq.q: How do we keep a Mangalore playground usable in the monsoon?
faq.a: Raise the base, slope it towards a drain and lay rubber flooring. Keep the play area away from roof runoff, which floods low corners in heavy rain.

faq.q: Does FunPlay supply hotels and colleges in Mangalore?
faq.a: Yes. We supply hotels, colleges, schools and housing projects. The equipment is made in Vasai and installed by our team or a regional dealer.

faq.q: Is laterite soil suitable for grouted installation?
faq.a: Yes, laterite holds concrete footings well when it is compacted. Loose fill around the posts should be avoided, since heavy rain washes it out.

intro: Mango sits across the Subarnarekha from Jamshedpur, and many of its families work in the steel city's plants and offices. Housing societies, schools and private colonies here are growing, and the play areas they plan are often squeezed between buildings. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,430 km away, and delivers it to Jharkhand by road.

The most common mistake we see on compact sites is placing equipment too close together. A swing needs clear space in front and behind, and a slide needs a run-out zone at its exit. On every project, we send a layout drawing with these safe play areas marked, so you can check the fit before approving the quote.

sections.html:
Every piece has a safe play area, the clear zone children need around it to play and fall without hitting something else. Safe zones can overlap only where children move in the same direction, never in front of a swing. Keep benches, trees, lamp posts and boundary walls outside these zones, and do not let a walkway cut through one.

If the space is tight, a single multi play system from our Forestia range uses one combined safe zone instead of several separate ones. Jharkhand's summers are hot and its monsoon heavy, so rubber flooring on a drained base works best underfoot. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Mango.

faq.q: What is a safe play area?
faq.a: It is the clear zone around a piece of equipment where children play, move and may fall. It must be free of walls, benches and other equipment. We mark it on every layout drawing.

faq.q: Do you supply societies in Mango and Jamshedpur?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

faq.q: Can two pieces share a safe play area?
faq.a: Only in limited cases, and never in front of or behind a swing. A multi play system is often the better option on small sites.

intro: Mathura and nearby Vrindavan draw pilgrims from across India all year, and the gardens, ashrams and guest houses that serve them see a steady stream of visiting families. Equipment in these public spaces is used hard by children who are there for a day and gone the next. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,030 km away, and sends it to western Uttar Pradesh by road.

We also supply the city's schools, housing colonies and municipal parks. Share your site size, the kind of visitors you expect and some photos. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and, once you approve, manufacture and install it through our own team or a dealer in north India.

sections.html:
Where children are unfamiliar with the equipment and parents are often busy, simple pieces with fixed parts are the safer choice. Swings, slides and see-saws are easy for any child to understand. Avoid loose or detachable parts, and choose grouted installation so nothing can be moved.

Put seating where parents can watch, such as a bench or gazebo from our garden decor range. Mathura's summers are very hot and the winters cold, so shade over the play area and galvanised, roto-moulded equipment make sense here. Fitness options for the same site are on our Mathura outdoor gym page.

faq.q: What equipment works for an ashram or guest house garden in Mathura?
faq.a: Simple fixed pieces such as swings, a slide and a see-saw, grouted in place, with seating for parents nearby. They are easy for visiting children to use safely.

faq.q: Do you supply Vrindavan as well as Mathura?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in the region and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.

faq.q: How do we plan for heavy use by visitors?
faq.a: Choose sturdy galvanised and roto-moulded equipment, grout it in place and set a regular inspection routine. Report any damage to our after-sales team promptly.

intro: Mau, in eastern Uttar Pradesh, is a weaving town where many schools are still building their first proper play area. Principals here usually ask us one question first: what should we buy if we can only buy a few things this year? FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,310 km away, and delivers it to eastern UP by road.

We answer that question with a plan for your ground, not a catalogue. Send us its size, the classes that will use it and some photos. We will suggest a starter set and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing, leaving room for pieces you may add later. Our team or a dealer in north India handles installation.

sections.h: A starter playground for a school
sections.html:
1. A double swing set, which is the most used piece on almost any school ground.
  2. A slide of a height that suits your youngest regular users.
  3. A see-saw or merry-go-round, which lets several children play together.
  4. Rubber flooring under the swings and slide exit.

This set covers swinging, sliding and group play, and it fits on a modest ground. Eastern UP has hot summers, a humid monsoon and cold winters, and galvanised frames with roto-moulded parts handle all three. When your next budget comes in, a multi play system can go into space already marked on the layout.

faq.q: What should a school in Mau buy first?
faq.a: A swing set, a slide and a see-saw or merry-go-round, with rubber flooring under them. This covers the main types of play on a modest budget.

faq.q: Can we add equipment later?
faq.a: Yes. We mark space for future pieces on the first layout drawing, so new equipment can be installed without moving what you already have.

faq.q: How is equipment delivered to eastern Uttar Pradesh?
faq.a: It is sent by road from our Vasai factory. Our own installation team or a dealer in north India sets it up, grouted or self-standing.
